metadata.title: महाराजा की रसोई के राज़ | Manikya Royal Family Kitchen | The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
In this episode, we take you inside the hidden culinary world of the Manikya royal family of Tripura. The recipes and traditions have been passed down for generations, keeping the royal kitchen's offerings a well-guarded secret.
Join us as we uncover the exquisite dishes that have sustained the royal family, revealing the palace chefs’ unique flavours and cooking techniques. From traditional Tripuri delicacies to rare, ceremonial meals, the royal kitchens are a treasure trove of culinary history.
In this special episode, we’ll also unveil the favourite dish of the current head of the royal family, Maharaja Pradyot Kishor Manikya. Known for his love of traditional cuisine, Maharaja Pradyot’s favourite food reflects the rich cultural heritage of Tripura, with a touch of regal taste. Watch as we take you on a journey through time, showing how royal kitchens still maintain their secrets, while also revealing the delicious legacy they have preserved.
